messages:
maria: opened a docs PR to publish an on-prem KMS migration + examples pack. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4372. It's focused on moving from legacy-kms-shim -> pkcs11-backed HSM or cloud-kms fallback.

aj: will reviewers need to validate install matrix? some customers are still on older installers (1.7/1.8).

maria: yes, i'll add an installer compatibility table mapping installer_version -> supported_kms_adapter -> recommended_action. also include a short note for semiairgap installs.

ryan: can we call out kv-cache and token issues explicitly? i had a customer roll back and hit stale tokens. suggest `kv-cache flush` before downgrades and a rollback checklist.

sophie: i'll update SDK snippets. plan to add python + go minimal examples (rotate key, sign token) and a YAML example for installer config. python sample:

```python
from redwood_sdk import KMSClient
client = KMSClient(kms_provider='hsm', module_path='/usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so')
client.rotate_key('redwood-main-key')
```

and go sample:

```go
kc := kms.NewClient(kms.WithProvider("hsm"), kms.WithModule("/usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so"))
kc.RotateKey(ctx, "redwood-main-key")
```

aj: small nit: use `kms_provider: \"hsm\"` in the YAML installer examples to align with CLI flags.

maria: noted. also found a broken anchor on the networking page: the `#networking-ports` anchor 404s in prod. i'll fix the heading and add a redirect.

infra-bot: deploy preview built: https://deploy-preview-4372--docs.redwood.ai/knb/onprem/kms-migration (status: success)

sophie: for airgapped installs, include where to place pkcs11 modules and a SHA256 check for tarballs. customers often forget to install the module before starting the agent.

maria: drafting an examples/migrate-hsm.sh helper. keeping it explicit opt-in with `--dry-run`. will include systemd restart snippet and warnings about cert copy vs symlink.

aj: i'll add a tiny lint/test for the snippets and run the docs snippet linter. take care to avoid secrets in examples.

ryan: add a rollback subsection: steps to revert, when to run `kv-cache flush`, and how to rebind keys if necessary. also a short troubleshooting FAQ (common errors, permission issues for pkcs11 module).

maria: checklist in PR body:
- [x] draft migration guide
- [ ] installer compatibility table
- [ ] airgap tarball + module placement notes
- [ ] SDK snippets (py/go) + changelog blurb
- [ ] examples/migrate-hsm.sh (opt-in, dry-run)
- [ ] link fixes + anchor redirects
- [ ] final review + merge

sophie: i'll draft the SDK changelog paragraph about parameter name changes and a short note for downstream teams.

maria: target merge: EOD Friday. flag blockers here. :pray: 

doc-bot: Reminder: consider adding a small eval prompt set to monitor quality after migration (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/evals).
